raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in biological knowledge by incorrectly associating the protection of the brain from physical impact with the nervous system. While the nervous system contains the brain, the specific function of "protecting the brain from getting bumped" (physical trauma) is the primary role of the skull, which is part of the skeletal system. The Planner failed to distinguish between the organ itself (brain/nervous system) and the structural protection provided by the surrounding bone (skeletal system), leading to an incorrect selection of option B instead of the correct option C.
